structure:
A 60-line ruling file, workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-ian-2026-11-25b.md, from Ian on 25 November 2026 (his second that day). It answers the two notification view header questions the 25 November re-distil raised from ruling:sam-2026-11-19 point 2. An intro (lines 1-5), then two sections: '## c-438: Amend becomes a link' (lines 7-27: a verbatim answer quote, the ruling in bold, and four 'why' bullets covering today's posting header, the POST that only renders a page, Delete's href pattern and why point 2 is unweakened) and '## c-447: plants gets Copy as new' (lines 29-60: a verbatim answer quote, the ruling in bold, four bullets naming the plants backend, persistence and engine code already on main, the missing header copyAction, the repo and increment consequences for inc-123 and inc-124, and an orchestrator's note on reading the carried-over against cleared split against plants' own fields). Scope is the whole file; nothing is left out.

Extracted in 1 part:
Part 1, Whole ruling: Read the whole ruling file, workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-ian-2026-11-25b.md, lines 1 to 60. It is an intro (lines 1-5) naming the two notification view header questions raised from ruling:sam-2026-11-19 point 2 while picking up the manage-notifications theme, then two sections. '## c-438: Amend becomes a link' (lines 7-27): the verbatim answer quote 'A link, like Delete', the ruling in bold (lines 11-13), and four 'why' bullets (lines 17-27) on today's posting header, the POST that would only render a page, Delete's href pattern, and point 2 being unweakened. '## c-447: plants gets Copy as new' (lines 29-60): the verbatim answer quote, the ruling in bold (lines 33-35), the wiring-not-feature statement and four bullets naming plants backend, persistence and engine code already on main (lines 37-47), the missing plants copyAction and route (lines 49-51), the repo and increment consequences for inc-123 and inc-124 (lines 53-55), and an orchestrator's note (lines 57-60) on reading the carried-over against cleared split against plants' own fields. Every decision, reason, code fact, consequence and the orchestrator's note is claimed, plus gaps for what the ruling touches and leaves open. The part has no keeps.

The ruling does not name the plants Copy as new route's path, nor say where the plants copy lands the trader after copying.

The ruling applies 'Amend a link to the amend confirmation page' to plants too, but does not say whether the amend confirmation page (inc-120) is built for plants or whether plants' Amend stays a posting button until it is.

The ruling does not say the order or presentation (button or link styling) of the three header actions, nor the plants Copy as new label beyond the name 'Copy as new'.
